text:
marta (infra): FYI - cluster scale-outs in eu-west-1 started failing around 04:12 UTC, seeing lots of 429s from the cloud SG API when creating security groups.
kevin (platform): :eyes: is this the per-minute SG API quota again? any support case opened?
marta (infra): opened case 7890123451. Support replied that account-level SG create calls are rate-limited to ~200 calls/min per region (soft limit). They suggested reusing SGs or batching rules instead of creating per-deployment SGs.
ryan (oncall): rolling back the canary to stop further churn. canary rollback triggered at 04:20.
deploy-bot: deploy failed: create_security_group -> HTTP 429 (RateExceeded) -> retrying with backoff. 
kevin (platform): current provisioning pattern creates one SG per nodepool+env+deploy (for strict isolation). That multiplies quickly during parallel jobs. We need short-term mitigations and a long-term plan.
marta (infra): short-term patch proposed: change provisioner to check for an existing SG with our naming convention and re-use if present. Also add exponential backoff + circuit breaker on SG create calls. Example snippet I pushed to PR:
```bash
# pseudo-provisioner logic
existing_sg=$(aws ec2 describe-security-groups --filters Name=tag:Name,Values="redwood-${cluster}-${env}-sg" --query "SecurityGroups[0].GroupId" --output text)
if [ "$existing_sg" != "None" ]; then
  attach_sg "$existing_sg"
else
  create_sg_with_retries
fi
```
kevin (platform): :+1: that'll reduce calls a lot. but it changes isolation guarantees. we should document the risk and add extra rule hygiene (tag ownership, ip-ranges).
ryan (oncall): quick monitoring asks: can we emit metrics for SG create rate per account/region and alert on >100/min? want early warning before hitting 200.
marta (infra): added a prometheus rule prototype in the branch. alert: sg_create_rate{region="eu-west-1"} > 100 for 1m -> pager.
aws-support: Thanks for the case. We see elevated API create calls from your account. We can raise the soft limit but it may take 24-72 hours. Meanwhile, re-use or reducing create rate is recommended. Case ref: 7890123451.
kevin (platform): long-term: evaluate using shared security groups per-tenant or per-cluster with rule diffs, and consider moving some rules to NACLs where possible. Also estimate cost of losing per-deploy isolation vs operational overhead.
marta (infra): also flagged in infra ops doc that multi-AZ parallel provisioning exacerbates this because each AZ creates SGs. I'll open a follow-up to collapse SGs per-region instead of per-AZ.
ryan (oncall): one gotcha: re-using SGs requires careful cleanup for rule accumulation. add owner tag + periodic rule compaction job.
kevin (platform): agree. please include rollback steps and feature flag for the change. don't force reuse until we validate on staging.
marta (infra): will gate behind ff and run canaries slowly (1 cluster every 10m). patch rolled to staging at 05:10; staging provision rate stayed under limit.
kevin (platform): once support confirms limit increase, we can still keep reuse as default to avoid future spikes.
marta (infra): filing follow-up doc with timeline, PR link, and support case details. PR: https://git.redwood/infraprov/merge_requests/432
ryan (oncall): nice - add runbook entry: how to manually attach existing SG if create fails during emergency scaling.
marta (infra): done. runbook link: https://wiki.redwood/infra/sg-provisioning-rate-limits
kevin (platform): :shipit: thanks all.
ryan (oncall): :facepalm: learned the hard way. keep an eye on the alerts overnight.
